description: Palette of email building blocks from the block registry, grouped by category, plus a set of column-layout presets. A search field filters the tiles by their localized name (diacritics- and case-insensitive) with a localized empty state, tiles show the icon above a wrapping label whose full name is in title, and a collapse toggle folds the palette to its rail. Clicking or dragging a block raises the add/drag callbacks, and choosing a preset inserts a new section.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the palette is collapsed to its rail. Collapsing hides the search field and the tile groups (the toggle stays, so the panel is never a dead end); the editor maps this to the left panel width and F8 maps it to TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels (D10).

parameters.name: CollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new collapsed state when the palette's toggle is used.

parameters.name: OnAddBlock
parameters.description: Raised when a block is chosen (clicked) to be added.

parameters.name: OnAddSection
parameters.description: Raised when a layout preset is chosen to add as a new section.

parameters.name: OnDragBlockStart
parameters.description: Raised when a block drag starts (for drag-and-drop onto the canvas).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true the tiles stay visible but inert: not draggable, aria-disabled, and neither a click nor a keyboard activation raises OnAddBlock/OnAddSection.

parameters.name: ShowCollapseToggle
parameters.description: Whether the palette renders its own collapse arrow. Defaults to true; a host that owns the shell chrome sets it to false so the same state has one control instead of two (Faze 8 maps ToolboxCollapsed onto TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels, whose panel toggle is then the only arrow).
